title: Purpose
description:
Schema for purpose records. Each record names a presentation objective such as informing, aligning, persuading, driving a decision, or selling. Documents reference a purpose from 'purpose', which also accepts free-form text and inline Purpose objects.

A document references a record as a bare id or 'name:id' and resolves it in its own catalogs groups first, then in the catalog the host registered for the group's source; engines never fetch a catalog. A published record file carries '$schema' and 'id'; the copy a document embeds under catalogs.<group>.<kind>.<id> carries neither (the key is the id) and no 'x-*' display metadata.

$schema.description: Identifies a published record file as a purpose record. Required in a published file; an embedded copy omits it.

id.description: The purpose's id in its catalog, lowercase kebab-case. Required in a published record file; a document references the record by it (a bare id, or 'name:id' for a named group) and embeds it keyed by it, without this field.

name.description: Human-readable purpose name shown in pickers.

summary.description: One-sentence positioning of the purpose — what this deck is trying to accomplish.

description.description: Longer prose describing when to use this purpose and how it should shape a deck.

outcome.description: Desired audience outcome after the presentation.

successCriteria.description: Observable signals that the deck accomplished this purpose.

recommendedNarratives.description: Soft cross-link: ids of narratives in the same catalog that work well for this purpose. Never resolved, embedded or validated as references.

recommendedTones.description: Soft cross-link: ids of tones in the same catalog that work well for this purpose. Never resolved, embedded or validated as references.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and search.

preview.description: Visual previews of the record, used by picker UIs and inline rendering. All sub-fields are optional.

thumbnailSrc.description: Smaller thumbnail preview suited to dense grid views.

vectorSrc.description: SVG / vector preview for crisp scaling at any size.
